Nora (docs): Opened a small PR documenting a split-horizon DNS / SNI gotcha for sealed-site HSM admin traffic and proposed troubleshooting snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1520
Felix (eng-infra): Nice catch. Can you include a quick haproxy tcp-mode example and an SNI override pattern? Some customers terminate TLS at the proxy and forget to set SNI to the HSM hostname.
Nora (docs): Added a minimal example and a low-dep probe. Snippet (paste-friendly):
```
# probe HSM admin with explicit SNI using openssl
openssl s_client -connect <hsm-proxy-ip>:<port> -servername <hsm-hostname> </dev/null
# alternate: curl with host resolution to force SNI
curl -I --resolve "<hsm-hostname>:<port>:<hsm-backend-ip>" https://<hsm-hostname>/:/ -k
# tcp-forwarding haproxy snippet (tcp mode)
frontend hsm_admin
  bind *:12345
  mode tcp
  default_backend hsm_back
backend hsm_back
  mode tcp
  server hsm1 <hsm-real-ip>:12345 send-proxy
```
Hari (security): Please add a clear warning about using -k / insecure flags only for diagnostics and call out SNI mismatch symptoms: TLS handshake success but application layer auth fails, or cert CN mismatch. Also remind to never post real hostnames.
Nora (docs): Added a short troubleshooting list with symptoms and remedies: 1) "certificate CN mismatch" -> check SNI and haproxy `use-server`/`sni` mapping; 2) "handshake ok but auth fails" -> ensure proxy isn't terminating TLS or rewrite Host header.
Tori (installer): Will add an installer flag `--hsm-proxy-mode` to document the expected behavior and a postinstall check that runs the openssl one-liner. Filing issue after merge.
deploy-bot: docs staging build passed (2026-03-29-1500) :white_check_mark:
Felix (eng-infra): Tiny nit: change the curl example to avoid `-k` in the doc block; keep it in prose as an optional diagnostic.
Nora (docs): Updated accordingly, replaced `-k` with a prose note. Marking PR ready for review and will ping eng-infra/security for a quick pass. Closing thread once merged.
